1031. Stack using Linked List

Medium

Problem Statement:
Creation of Linked List implementation of Stack ADT.
input_spec:
The first line of the input N is an integer denoting the number of elements in the stack S.
The second line of the input consists of the N space-separated stack element from bottom to top.
The third line of the input is the integer O denoting the operation that needs to be performed and additional new value X in case of the push operation.
The operations are as follows:

1- Push
2- Pop
output_spec: Print the stack from bottom to top in a space-separated format after performing the selected operation.
